title: Swing excursion versus realized net by exit cause
extraction_rule: Select aggregate MFE and realized net by observed exit cause; group counts retained. MFE is path excursion, not an executable return.

study_context.universe: current-only screener membership; historical survivorship tailwind
study_context.benchmark: equal-weight price-panel proxy for relative strength and market regime
study_context.costs: notional friction + tax convention in R units; V1 per-win conservative tax, V2 corrected annual net tax with constant risk per trade
study_context.execution: weekly as-of decisions; conservative bar-based fills; V1 fixed stop/far target/time exit; V2 trailing loss management
study_context.inference: reported bootstrap mean interval and shuffled-date placebo; exit alternatives are post-hoc same-fill diagnostics

caveats: R is trade P&L divided by initial planned trade risk; R is not a percentage return.
V1 and V2 are different designs and tax lines, not an isolated causal comparison.
Current-only membership and single 2026 adjusted-price vintage limit historical PIT claims.
The historical window is spent development data; V2 replay was kill-only and cannot pass the hypothesis.
V2 bear-regime expectancy and no_regime_half_sign_flip metric are null; a passing mechanical check does not establish bear evidence.
Grouping by realized exit cause is descriptive; it does not identify causal management value.
display_rounding: At most four decimals; integer counts unchanged
missing_values: null stays unavailable; never plotted as zero
transformation: One bar per recorded numeric value; no interpolation, resampling, inference or optimization
